meta.fields_policy: intended_* fields are what the operator says the link should point to. observed_* fields are what the request actually returned. A row is only publishable when intended_asin === observed_asin.
meta.price_policy: No price is published on this site. See claim C-09: Amazon permits display of price and availability only when Amazon serves the link or when the data comes from the Creators API / PA API.
meta.image_policy: No Amazon product photography is republished. See claim C-11 and C-12.
